title: Bluetooth, Android 10, disconnects when not on charge
symptom: Since update to Android 10, there are frequent disconnects. When the phone is on charge, there is no disconnect. The Dexcom app has no issue on the same phone.
cause: The thread suggests that Android's battery optimization interferes with xDrip running in the background, especially on OPPO's Color OS with strict battery saving management. The issue is likely due to vendor-specific adaptations to Android.
fix: The thread does not provide a definitive fix. Suggestions include disabling battery optimization, disabling Nightscout upload, and whitelisting xDrip, but these did not resolve the issue. The issue was closed without a solution.
evidence_quote: Every time I have seen this behavior, after an upgrade to Android 10, it has been resolved after the battery optimization was disabled and after the xDrip settings were corrected to match the recommended Android 10 xDrip settings. This is the only case I have seen where the problem has persisted.
